comment: Overrides for scripts/swiftpm-notices.py (Linux .deb). Keys under packages are SwiftPM identities from linux/Package.resolved. Every entry needs a reason.
preamble: The SwiftPM packages below are statically linked into /usr/bin/topdrawerd
and /usr/bin/topdrawer-shell and keep their own licenses.

dbus.reason: The 0.4.1 tag has no LICENSE file; its README states Apache-2.0 and points to one. Upstream added it in the next commit (wendylabsinc/dbus 5727296ecaef9655b781f82c7ebde5c9f0d45551, 'Create LICENSE', no code changes); this is that file, verbatim.

swift-async-algorithms.reason: A source-header template for upstream's lint tooling, not a license text; it does not ship. The package's license is LICENSE.txt.

swift-collections.reason: A source-header template for upstream's lint tooling, not a license text; it does not ship. The package's license is LICENSE.txt.

swift-crypto.reason: Sources/CCryptoBoringSSL vendors BoringSSL at revision 0226f30467f540a3f62ef48d453f93927da199b6 (its hash.txt), including third_party/fiat, without their license files. These are BoringSSL's LICENSE and third_party/fiat/{LICENSE,AUTHORS} at that revision, verbatim. BoringSSL's LICENSE also quotes the Go license, which it says covers only TLS test-suite code that is not compiled into libcrypto, so every shipped text is Apache-2.0.

swift-nio.reason: Sources/CNIOAtomics/src/cpp_magic.h is uSHET's lib/cpp_magic.h at c09e0acafd86720efe42dc15c63e0cc228244c32 (named in swift-nio's NOTICE.txt as MIT) and carries no copyright line of its own. This is uSHET's LICENSE at that commit, verbatim. llhttp's text ships in the checkout (Sources/CNIOLLHTTP/LICENSE).
